pdf_lines_free: Disinfectant: free chlorine. Measured species: free chlorine (mg/L as Cl2); every reading and map value is free chlorine.
Minimum residual: 0.2 mg/L free chlorine: a common operating minimum, not a California rule (California requires a detectable residual).

Season: water temperature and organics (TOC) are not inputs; their effect is absorbed into the decay rates, refitted from the last three months of samples (temperature and TOC models were tested in simulation and not adopted).
Validated in simulation only: no real grab-sample data has been scored yet.

detail.full: Grid edge: 100% of the calibration sits on the lowest bulk decay rate the grid allows (0.1 per day). The water may need a rate outside the grid, so treat the map with more caution there. In simulation the free-chlorine fit often sat at this floor of 0.10 per day (journal, tasks 10b, 11 and 13), and today's map was biased low in those simulations; the cause is not settled. A grid with lower rates was tested and is a candidate, not yet the default.
detail.chloramine: Grid edge: 100% of the calibration sits on the highest wall decay rate the grid allows (1 m/day). The water may need a rate outside the grid, so treat the map with more caution there.
